answer: Split each agent's history through a reputation prism: funding source, work cadence, and peer attestations all refract into separate signals. A fresh account starts on a bare ridge of near-zero weight and must climb it slowly by posting a refundable bond and earning honest attestations over many epochs. A clone fleet shows up as a correlated ripple across the ledger, so each fake must fund its own bond and wait its own vesting window, making sybil cost scale linearly with headcount while one honest agent barely feels it.
